title: Sembcorp Said to Plan Filing for $500 Million IPO of India Unit
summary: Singapore-based Sembcorp Industries Ltd. is preparing to file for an initial public offering of its Indian unit, Sembcorp Green Infra Ltd., that could raise as much as $500 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Anwar Avoids Coalition Turmoil as Key Party Stays in Cabinet
summary: Malaysia’s Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim won a rare political reprieve over the weekend, after a string of electoral setbacks and turmoil within his own party, as the biggest component of his ruling coalition voted to stay in cabinet.

title: First Gen Falls by Record 19% After Parent Rejected KKR Offer
summary: Shares of First Gen Corp., one of the Philippines’ largest renewable energy companies, fell by a record on Monday after its parent turned down an offer from KKR to buy additional shares and take it private.

title: BlueScope's Archibald: Focused on Organic Growth
summary: BlueScope Steel MD and CEO Tania Archibald says her company is very much focused on organic growth and intends to improve shareholder returns over an extended period. She speaks with Yvonne Man and David Ingles on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Xi Ties Predecessor’s Legacy to His Agenda as Global Risks Rise
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping invoked the legacy of his predecessor Jiang Zemin to advance his own economic and global policy agenda, warning of “high winds and rough waters” as China faces slowing growth and rising tensions abroad.

title: Goldman Says Markets Too Hawkish on Betting Fed Will Hike Rates
summary: Market bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes are still too aggressive given that inflation in the world’s biggest economy is cooling, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.

title: India Readies LPG Output Boost as Hormuz Uncertainty Lingers
summary: India has directed refiners to boost cooking gas production, seeking to bolster domestic supplies ahead of the upcoming festival season as uncertainty over the Strait of Hormuz threatens imports.

title: Copper Heads Toward Record High on LME as Supply Tensions Build
summary: Copper rose toward a record, with a key price spread in London widening to unusual levels in a sign of intense competition for supply.

title: Dollar Weakens as Traders Pare Fed Rate-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
summary: The dollar fell against most of its major peers after weak US economic data reduced bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month.

title: Korea Eximbank to Lend $1 Billion to Glencore for Copper Supply
summary: Export-Import Bank of Korea will lend $1 billion to commodities giant Glencore Plc in exchange for copper supply to South Korean companies, as the country seeks to secure raw materials needed for the artificial intelligence boom.

title: Indonesian Developer Modernland Seeks Bond Restructuring Again
summary: Distressed Indonesian property firm PT Modernland Realty is seeking to restructure a dollar bond for a second time, highlighting liquidity challenges facing the builder of residential and industrial townships.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for June 17
summary: Oil rose as fresh fighting in Lebanon and attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz muddied the outlook for a deal to end the US-Iran war.

title: Japan’s Bond Yields Climb on BOJ Hike Bets, Fiscal Concerns
summary: Japan’s bonds fell on fiscal concerns and growing speculation that the Bank of Japan may raise interest rates in the coming months, pushing the 10-year yield to the highest since 1996.

title: Gold Rises to Near $4,400 as Weak Retail Data Weighs on Dollar
summary: Gold extended a two-week advance as weaker US retail sales data weighed on the US dollar, making bullion cheaper for most buyers.

title: India Rupee, Bonds in Focus as RBI to End FCNR Deposit Window Early
summary: The end of the deposit plan could tighten banking system liquidity.

title: Hong Kong Court Orders Unit of SDIC Commodities to Liquidate
summary: A unit of China’s state-backed SDIC Commodities Co. was ordered to liquidate by a Hong Kong court, adding to the financial troubles for the metals trader as Beijing increases scrutiny on the sector.

title: ‘Too Big to Ban’ WuXi AppTec Gains 100% on GLP-1 Chokehold
summary: The Pentagon’s designation of WuXi AppTec Co. as a Chinese military company may have prompted some US clients to pull back, but investors are still piling into the stock betting the firm will remain central to the global supply of obesity, cancer and other drugs.

title: Trump Says He’s Curtailing Drills With South Korea
summary: President Donald Trump said he told the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” joint military exercises with South Korea, citing the cost of the drills and the signal they send to North Korea. Bloomberg’s Jon Herskovitz breaks down the situation. (Corrects spelling mistake in reporter’s name.) (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Silver Traders Brave Red Tape to Capture Indian Premiums
summary: Shipments of silver into India are picking up despite administrative hurdles, as traders seek to capitalize on attractive premiums after a new licensing regime disrupted imports.

title: NAB Shares Drop as Mortgage Growth in Australia Seen Slowing
summary: National Australia Bank Ltd. shares fell Monday after the lender revealed slowing mortgage growth and cash earnings that were below consensus estimates.
